risk: Denial of service at DOCUMENTATION BUILD TIME only. `image-size`'s ICNS parser loops forever on a crafted `.icns` file, so an attacker able to place one where Docusaurus reads it would hang `npm run build` until the job's timeout. The exposure is a build that stops, not a build that lies: no output is produced, nothing is published, and no data is disclosed or altered. There is no runtime exposure at all — the vulnerable code runs on a CI runner during a docs build and nowhere else.
reason: GRANTED BECAUSE THERE IS NOTHING TO TAKE. No fixed release of `image-size` exists and no reachable upgrade of a direct dependency removes it, so the alternatives are an exception or a blocked pipeline on a build-time-only denial of service that the site's own content cannot trigger. Time-bounded at 60 days on M's ruling of 2026-09-08, with removal on the first upstream fix rather than at expiry.
mitigation: IN FORCE NOW, all four checkable in this tree. (1) NOT SHIPPED: `docs/` is a build-time documentation toolchain and is outside the Python distribution — the wheel carries no npm dependency, `gates/wheel_install.py`'s closure check is what says so, and `pip-audit --strict` over the wheel's frozen closure reports no known vulnerability. (2) NOT REACHED: `@docusaurus/mdx-loader` calls `image-size` only to measure an image a page references, and this site references none — no `![`, no `` and no `require()` of an image anywhere under `docs/docs` or `docs/src`; the only image in the tree is `docs/static/img/favicon.ico`, and `static/` is copied rather than parsed. (3) NO FRESH RESOLUTION: CI installs the docs toolchain with `npm ci` from the committed `docs/package-lock.json`, so the version audited is the version built. (4) ENFORCED, NOT INTENDED: the `docs-audit` job in `.github/workflows/ci.yml` fails on any high or critical npm advisory that is not exactly this file or its sibling, and it derives that allowlist from this directory through `gates/codeql_gate.py --emit-pip-audit-ignores` rather than carrying a list of its own — so on 2026-11-08, the day after `expiry`, the job goes red without anybody editing it, and `tests/test_cdm_security_exceptions.py` fails the whole suite on the same day.
upstream_status: NO FIX EXISTS. `image-size` has published nothing after 2.0.2 — `npm view image-size version` reads 2.0.2 on 2026-09-08 and its `versions` array ends there — and GitHub's advisory gives no patched version, so `first_patched_version` on the Dependabot alert is null and there is no upgrade to take. The advisory is OPEN and unpatched; no upstream release, branch or pull request fixing it was published as of 2026-09-08. The package is transitive under `@docusaurus/mdx-loader@3.10.2`, pinned by `@docusaurus/core@3.10.2`, which is the newest Docusaurus 3 release there is, so no bump of a direct dependency reaches it and an npm `overrides` entry has nothing to point at. REMOVAL TRIGGER, either of two events: an `image-size` release that carries a fix (which falls outside this file's `version_range` of `<=2.0.2`, deliberately, so a fixed release is never silently covered by this exception), or a `@docusaurus/mdx-loader` release that no longer depends on `image-size`. On either event M's ruling of 2026-09-08 requires this file to be DELETED and the dependency upgraded at that point rather than at `expiry` — and `expiry` is the backstop for the case where neither event happens.
